test.create_query: CREATE TABLE rf_stats_probe (id UInt64, g UInt16, payload UInt64) ENGINE MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = ''
CREATE TABLE rf_stats_build (id UInt64, g UInt16, payload UInt64) ENGINE MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = 'minmax,uniq,tdigest'
CREATE TABLE rf_stats_build_no_stats (id UInt64, g UInt16, payload UInt64) ENGINE MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = ''
CREATE TABLE rf_stats_gate (id UInt64) ENGINE MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = 'minmax,uniq,tdigest'
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO rf_stats_probe SELECT number, number % 1024, number FROM numbers_mt(20000000)
INSERT INTO rf_stats_build SELECT number, number % 16, number FROM numbers_mt(2000000)
INSERT INTO rf_stats_build_no_stats SELECT number, number % 16, number FROM numbers_mt(2000000)
INSERT INTO rf_stats_gate SELECT number FROM numbers_mt(16)
ALTER TABLE rf_stats_build MATERIALIZE STATISTICS ALL SETTINGS mutations_sync=1
ALTER TABLE rf_stats_gate MATERIALIZE STATISTICS ALL SETTINGS mutations_sync=1
